rulebook_authority: Only the owner-designated human authority may approve, sign and publish official Rulebook policy. This matrix is a proposal until explicitly approved.

evidence_levels.name: Assertion
evidence_levels.meaning: A record states that a control passed.

evidence_levels.name: Reproducible local check
evidence_levels.meaning: Command, inputs and output are retained to repeat a check.
evidence_levels.limitations: Local environment and operator remain in the trust boundary.

evidence_levels.name: CI-bound evidence
evidence_levels.meaning: Run and job identity, repository and commit are checked against CI metadata.
evidence_levels.limitations: Depends on configured CI provider and workflow trust.

evidence_levels.name: Cryptographically attested artifact
evidence_levels.meaning: Artifact digest and signer/workflow identity are verified under a declared external trust model.
evidence_levels.limitations: Does not prove scientific truth, legal rights or human policy approval.

evidence_levels.name: Independent review or witness
evidence_levels.meaning: Evidence is checked in a separately governed trust domain.
evidence_levels.limitations: Independence and review scope must be documented; not an absolute guarantee.

subsystems.name: AL source, parser and compiler
subsystems.failure_disposition: DENY invalid or prohibited source; REVIEW unresolved compatibility.

subsystems.name: Package and dependency resolver
subsystems.failure_disposition: DENY integrity or licence failure; REVIEW unknown provenance.

subsystems.name: Runtime and execution engine
subsystems.failure_disposition: DENY absent capability or failed sandbox; REVIEW unknown policy.

subsystems.name: AI inference and assistant
subsystems.boundary: Generate, explain or transform AL content.
subsystems.failure_disposition: Treat output as untrusted; DENY execution until validated; REVIEW policy ambiguity.

subsystems.name: Dataset ingestion and preparation
subsystems.boundary: Import, clean, transform or export data.
subsystems.failure_disposition: DENY prohibited or unlicensed use; REVIEW uncertain rights or basis.

subsystems.name: Training, fine-tuning and evaluation
subsystems.boundary: Train, tune, select or evaluate models.
checks: Approved dataset set and training protocol
evidence: Metric cards, logs and evaluation report
subsystems.failure_disposition: DENY unapproved inputs or failed mandatory metrics; REVIEW unset thresholds.

subsystems.name: Scientific and agronomy modules
subsystems.boundary: Calculate, simulate or publish scientific outputs.
subsystems.failure_disposition: DENY dimensional or validation failure; REVIEW unsupported assumptions.

subsystems.name: Build, CI and release
subsystems.boundary: Build binaries, images, installers and publish releases.
subsystems.failure_disposition: DENY failed or unverifiable release gate.

subsystems.name: Rulebook Update Center
subsystems.boundary: Discover, stage, approve, publish or roll back policy.
subsystems.failure_disposition: DENY unauthorized publication; REVIEW disputed or unverified source.

subsystems.name: Audit, evidence and trust services
subsystems.failure_disposition: DENY tampering or revocation; REVIEW unavailable or stale trust anchor.

unknowns_policy: NOT_SET; do not infer or invent thresholds.
